verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say users can customize, run, print, or export payroll reports and share them with an accountant, which covers the generate-and-export core of the story. Nothing in the evidence specifically names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports, export formats, or analysis-ready output. missing for 10: explicit payroll register and gross-to-net report types, documented export formats (e.g. CSV/Excel), independent or hands-on corroboration.
